repo.description:
### Impact

Sites that rely on the tagging system and have tag group restrictions set up to restrict the visibility and usage of tags to specific groups are affected when any of those restricted tag groups are attached to a publicly readable category as `allowed_tags`, `allowed_tag_groups`, or a required tag group. The restricted tag and tag-group names then leak to anonymous and unauthorized users through various category and group endpoints in the application.

### Workarounds

If upgrading immediately is not possible, the disclosure can be eliminated by removing the restricted tag and tag-group references from any publicly-readable category:

1. For each publicly-readable category, review its tag settings: "Restrict these tags to this category", "Restrict these tag groups to this category", and "Require new topics to have tags from tag groups".
2. Remove any tag group that is restricted to a specific group such as staff, admins, or a custom group
3. Remove any individual tags that belong to one of those restricted tag groups.
repo.summary: Hidden tag names leaked via category serializers
